label: Road Bike
description: Lightweight and fast. Limited bag mounts but great for road events like TGE.

label: Gravel Bike
description: The most popular choice for BAS events. Multiple bag mounts, versatile geometry.

label: Touring Bike
description: Built for carrying heavy loads. Front and rear racks, maximum capacity.

label: MTB Hardtail
description: Tough and capable off-road. Some riders use these for gravel events.

label: MTB Full Suspension
description: Maximum off-road comfort but less space for bags. Rare for bikepacking.
